risk.rationale: One codefire dispatcher carries the request ledger/deadline, sealed-session and authority owners, response publication, cleanup precedence and reducer seams for every Python HTTP route. The composition performs a real three-way merge on that single file across two independently accepted lineages, omits a duplicated initial patch, and must leave the still-open B3 post-effect surface byte-identical. A frozen rejecting shared-primitives BLOCK and two accepted trees disagree about the same symbol, so manager conflict resolution is required and isolated reviews cannot validate it. The lane is additionally topology-sensitive: candidate, writer result and reviewer report must be three separate linear commits because a candidate cannot record its own identity.
